name: Progress & Completion
description: Patterns that visualise how far a user has come toward a defined end-point, such as meters, checklists and rings.

name: Goals & Challenges
description: Patterns built around explicit targets — fixed or adaptive — that a user sets out to reach.

name: Habits & Consistency
description: Patterns that track and reinforce repeated behaviour over time, typically on a daily or weekly cadence.

name: Achievements & Recognition
description: Patterns that mark milestones with a discrete, collectible signal of accomplishment.

name: Levels & Mastery
description: Patterns that structure growth into discrete tiers reflecting increasing skill, effort or status.

name: Rewards & Incentives
description: Patterns that offer a tangible or virtual benefit in exchange for a target behaviour.

name: Collections & Discovery
description: Patterns built around gathering a set of items or finding new content within a product.

name: Competition & Comparison
description: Patterns that rank or compare a user's performance against others, directly or informally.

name: Collaboration & Community
description: Patterns that connect multiple users around a shared activity, commitment or outcome.

name: Unlocking & Access
description: Patterns that reveal new content, features or capability in response to a qualifying action.

name: Feedback & Reinforcement
description: Patterns that respond to a user's action with information or encouragement intended to shape future behaviour.

name: Narrative & Exploration
description: Patterns that frame a user's activity or data as a story, encouraging curiosity rather than a fixed objective.
